money that a company gives back to a customer

broken or not in good condition

reading.rtitle: Email from Robert -- A Problem with the Delivery
paras: Dear Karina, I am writing about the new jet. The delivery date was May fifth, but the aircraft is not here. Today is May nineteenth. This delay is a big problem for my company, because we have a trip to Chicago on June first.
There is also a mistake in the invoice. The price on the invoice is ten thousand dollars more than the price in our contract. And one box with spare parts arrived damaged.
I am not happy, Karina. Please call me today. I need a solution and a new date for the delivery. Best regards, Robert.

bank.label: Useful lines for problems
items: I'm sorry about the delay.
I apologize for the mistake.
Let me check that for you.
I'll send you a new invoice today.
Don't worry. We have a solution.

listenings.text: Hello, this is Daniel Cole from Blue Sky Charter in Miami. I am calling about our order. We received the aircraft yesterday, thank you. But there is a problem. In the contract, the seats are gray, and the seats in the aircraft are brown. Also, the manual is only in Portuguese, and our pilots need a manual in English. Please call me back today or tomorrow, before five p.m. Thank you, and have a good day.

Hi, it's Sofia from Texas again. In my business, problems happen. A delivery is late, or a document has a mistake. Here is what I do. First, I listen. I don't interrupt the client. Second, I say sorry: I'm sorry about the problem. Third, I offer a solution: Let me check, or I'll send you a new document today. And I always call the client back the next day. Last month, a client had a big problem with a delay. Now he is my best customer!

extra_audio.text: First, Robert writes an email about the problems with his order. Then, Karina reads the email and calls him. Next, she says: I'm sorry about the delay. After that, she checks the new delivery date with the factory. Finally, she sends a new invoice, and Robert is happy with the solution.
